title: Tooltip
description: A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons.
when: Name an icon-only control; add a short hint to a truncated value.
a11y: Shown on focus too, linked with aria-describedby; never the only place of essential information.
The pointer can move onto the tooltip without it closing; Escape hides it (WCAG 1.4.13).
Enters with `animate-tooltip-in` (200ms, opacity + scale 0.96 → 1); opacity-only under prefers-reduced-motion.
